version.approval_notes:
VidGrab needs its companion helper program, which the add-on reaches through native messaging (host name "vidgrab") and then a token-protected HTTP API on 127.0.0.1. The helper is open source in the same repository (helper/, Go) and is downloaded from https://github.com/wobkobi/VidGrab/releases/latest.

To test: download the helper for your system from that page and run it once (Windows: double-click vidgrab-windows-amd64.exe; macOS/Linux: chmod +x and run it with "install"). It registers the native host for this add-on id and downloads yt-dlp and ffmpeg on first use. Restart Firefox, open any YouTube video, and use the Download button beside the like/dislike buttons. Progress shows on the button and in the toolbar popup.

Without the helper the add-on only shows "VidGrab helper not installed" with a link to the download page. The add-on collects no data; it only talks to the local helper. No code is minified or generated.
